metadata.case_name: HAU KIT HO v. STARWAY INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT LTD T/A TAO HEUNG SUPER 88

injuries.description: fracture over the left lateral malleolus
source: she had a fall and suffered a fracture to her left ankle.
X-ray on admission showed a fracture over the left lateral malleolus.
Dr. Chiang commented that x-ray showed that the fracture of the distal tibula had well united.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: the left ankle was grossly swollen with a tender spot over lateral malleolus
Range of movement decreased because of pain
mild pain in left heel when she started walking
some blocking feeling in her left ankle when she moved her ankle in certain angle
discomfort in the malleolar region of the left lateral ankle when she lowered her body to sit down
wheelchair-bound for the 3 to 4 months after the accident
used a frame for support in walking for 2 to 3 months; later trying to walk with a walking stick

treatments_received: operation on 2001-09-06 for open reduction and screw fixation of the fracture
hospitalisation and discharge with a wheelchair
leg splint fixed in the operation removed in about 4 weeks
used a frame for support in walking for 2 to 3 months
bonesetter treatment at the Kwong Wah Hospital in Dec., 2002
an injection to her left ankle in Feb., 2003 which produced noted improvement
15 intramuscular injections to relieve knee pains in late February to early March, 2002
treatments_future: removal of screws (could be removed in about a year after the consolidation of the fracture)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: impairment of her ability to render household chores which were all done by her prior to the accident; after the accident, all such work was done by her husband

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: could not resume her habits of morning swimming or hiking
